title: Rat Extermination
description: Rats have eaten two months of stored grain out of the Guild cellars since spring. Warehouse-master Corin Petsch wants them cleared. Cheap work, and plenty of it.

objectives.description: Clear the rats out of the Guild cellars

notes: Threat: two months of stored grain eaten out of the Guild's cellars, a slow bleed on Warehouse-master Petsch's books. Giver motive: cheaper to pay a bounty once than keep losing grain weekly. Refusal: the loss keeps accruing against the Guild's ledger.
